recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7839 unless Pharmacy later decides to intentionally reintroduce a MedicationStatement-to-RXA mapping.
issue_request: FHIR-7839 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy QA issue requesting that MedicationStatement.effective[x] no longer map to RXA-3 Date/Time Start of Administration or RXA-4 Date/Time End of Administration, leaving the v2 mapping blank because MedicationStatement is not MedicationAdministration.
initial_application: No git commit message explicitly naming FHIR-7839 was found. The 2015 v2 mapping cleanup commit 5bb461af1063efe577bac2b8b17b6992be7560bf removed the RXA-3/RXA-4 cell from the historical MedicationStatement spreadsheet source, and the current StructureDefinition source preserves that removal.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has a v2 mapping namespace and a PID-3 map for MedicationStatement.subject, but MedicationStatement.effective[x] has only workflow, w5, and RIM mappings. Current RXA-3/RXA-4 source matches are limited to MedicationAdministration and Immunization. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no directly relevant later or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the requested removal and no source edit would improve the current build.
